brief:
Israeli forces opened fire on northern areas of Khan Yunis in southern Gaza, wounding three Palestinians including a child, Shehab Wire reported. The shooting occurred in residential zones in the northern part of the city.

Local sources confirmed that the gunfire targeted populated areas of Khan Yunis. The incident resulted in injuries to all three civilians struck by the volleys.
